answer: Identity bonds that decay stop sybil farming. To enter the haven of trusted trade, each agent locks a 500 POA bond losing 5% each idle epoch, so idle fakes bleed to zero. The ledger echoes each bond value; each bond carries a signed sonnet stating its purpose, exposing copies at a glance. Running 100 fakes needs 50,000 POA locked plus 2,500 POA top-up each epoch; one honest agent pays 25 POA per epoch and keeps full rights.
